Exercise A – Choose the correct answer
Topic vocabulary: Entertainment. Choose the best option A, B, C or D.
  • 1. I've got a/an ………… for the school play tomorrow. I really hope I get a main part!
    ✓ C audition (audition = a test performance to get a part)
  • 2. Did you read that ………… of the new Lloyd-Rice musical? It said it was awful!
    ✓ A review (a review of a show = a critical assessment)
  • 3. I'm going to stay in and ………… TV tonight.
    ✓ B watch (watch TV is the standard collocation)
  • 4. We really ………… ourselves at the party! Thanks so much for inviting us!
    ✓ B had fun (enjoy ourselves / had fun at the party)
  • 5. Ellie does a/an ………… each week for the local newspaper. It's usually quite funny.
    ✓ D cartoon (a cartoon = a humorous drawing in a newspaper)
  • 6. The water park we went to yesterday was fantastic, but the entrance ………… was a bit expensive.
    ✓ B fee (entrance fee = charge to enter)
  • 7. Vanilla Sky ………… Tom Cruise, Penélope Cruz and Cameron Diaz.
    ✓ C stars (stars = features as the lead actors)
  • 8. When you're learning to play a musical instrument, it's important to ………… for an hour or two every day.
    ✓ B practise (practise an instrument = do regular individual training)
  • 9. The play wasn't supposed to be a comedy, but everyone started laughing when some of the ………… fell over and hit one of the actors.
    ✓ A scenery (scenery = stage sets/backdrops)
  • 10. Louis de Bernières' ………… Captain Corelli's Mandolin, which is set on the Greek island of Cephallonia during the Second World War, was an international bestseller.
    ✓ D novel (a novel = a work of fiction; can be described as his novel)
  • 11. Have you ………… the joke about the guy who fell off a 20-metre-high ladder? He was fine – he fell off the bottom rung!
    ✓ C heard (have you heard the joke = the standard expression)
  • 12. Being the conductor of a large ………… is an extremely demanding job. You have to make sure about a hundred musicians are playing in time.
    ✓ D orchestra (a conductor leads an orchestra)

Phrases and collocations: choose the correct word in bold.

Exercise E – Circle the extra word in each sentence
Each sentence has one word that should not be there. Write that extra word.
  • 1. What time did you get to home last night?
    ✓ to (get home — no preposition needed: 'get to home' is wrong)
  • 2. You shouldn't make the fun of Tim just because he's smaller than you.
    ✓ the (make fun of — no article: 'make the fun of' is wrong)
  • 3. A number of contemporary art installations are on the show at the moment at the Zwyborg Gallery.
    ✓ No extra word (on show = on display; this is correct)
  • 4. Didn't you find out that joke funny?
    ✓ out (find + adjective: 'find that joke funny' — 'out' is extra)
  • 5. I guess we'll have to join up the queue.
    ✓ up (join the queue — 'join up' means something else; 'up' is extra here)
  • 6. Everyone sat there in the silence as the comedian stumbled through his routine.
    ✓ in (sit in silence — actually 'in the silence' has an extra 'the'... the extra word is 'the')
  • 7. It's not often I laugh out loud during a movie, but There's Something About Mary had me roaring out with laughter the whole time.
    ✓ out (roar with laughter — 'out' is extra)
  • 8. I'm never going to be part with this first edition of Dickens's Great Expectations.
    ✓ with (part with = give up, so 'be part with' has 'with' as extra)
  • 9. I have the impression of Sasha's thinking about giving up ballet classes.
    ✓ of (I have the impression that... — 'of' is extra)

Exercise I – Choose the correct answer (review)
Choose the best option A, B, C or D for each sentence.
  • 1. Could you ………… in the paper and see what's on TV tonight?
    ✓ C look (look in the paper = check what's inside)
  • 2. I'm reading a ………… set in Greece during the Second World War.
    ✓ A novel (a novel = a work of fiction; can be described specifically)
  • 3. Harry kept us ………… throughout the journey with his non-stop jokes.
    ✓ B entertained (keep someone entertained = amuse them)
  • 4. I never read ………… of films as I don't trust the critics' opinions.
    ✓ A reviews (film reviews = critical assessments)
  • 5. How did your ………… go? Do you think you'll be offered the main part?
    ✓ D audition (how did your audition go?)
  • 6. I'd love to work in show ………… . It's so glamorous!
    ✓ B business (show business = the entertainment industry)
  • 7. Joe told me a joke today but I didn't ………… it at all.
    ✓ A get (get a joke = understand why it's funny)
  • 8. I didn't like this album at first but it's really starting to ………… on me now.
    ✓ A grow (grow on someone = begin to appeal more)
